description: A two-dimensional mixer: eight inputs and four mix outputs are placed on an XY field, and each input feeds a mix output by how close the two are on that field.

params.text: Sets that input's place along the horizontal axis of the field.
Sets that input's place along the vertical axis of the field.
Scales the horizontal position CV for that input, -1 to 1, inverting it below zero and silencing it at the centre.
Scales the vertical position CV for that input, -1 to 1, inverting it below zero and silencing it at the centre.
Scales the modulation CV for that input, -1 to 1, inverting it below zero and silencing it at the centre.
Sets that mix output's place along the horizontal axis of the field.
Sets that mix output's place along the vertical axis of the field.
Scales the horizontal position CV for that mix output, -1 to 1, inverting it below zero and silencing it at the centre.
Scales the vertical position CV for that mix output, -1 to 1, inverting it below zero and silencing it at the centre.
Sets the level of that mix output, 0% to 200%.

inputs.text: The monophonic source for that channel.
Moves that input along the horizontal axis of the field, added to its position knob and scaled by the attenuverter for this port.
Moves that input along the vertical axis of the field, added to its position knob and scaled by the attenuverter for this port.
Modulates that input's radius, its amount, its horizontal or vertical offset, or sends it on a random walk, as picked on that channel's display menu.
Moves that mix output along the horizontal axis of the field, scaled by the attenuverter for this port.
Moves that mix output along the vertical axis of the field, scaled by the attenuverter for this port.
Selects which of that mix output's sixteen motion sequences is followed: a trigger steps forward, reverse or at random, or 0-10V or notes C4 to D sharp 5 pick one outright.
Sets how far that mix output has travelled along its motion sequence, the input voltage mapping onto the length of the sequence.

outputs.text: The mix of every input whose radius reaches that output's place on the field, scaled by that output's volume.
Carries that input scaled by its amount and by its distance to each mix output, combined in the output mode picked on that channel's display menu, despite the tooltip calling it a direct output.

notes: a motion sequence is recorded by clicking the mix channel's number display, then dragging on the field; preset paths such as circles, saws and spirals are on the same menu.
the second Fold entry on OUT-port folds at -5V to 5V, although the menu prints its name as Fold 0..10V, exactly like the first one.
menu: Number of IN-ports and Number of MIX-ports — on the XY field's own right-click menu, setting how many input channels from 1 to 8 and mix channels from 1 to 4 are active.
Amount, Radius, X-port, Y-port, MOD-port and OUT-port — on an input channel's own display menu, or on that input's dot on the field.
OUT-port — Scale divides by the number of mix ports, Limit holds it to 100%, Clip 0..10V and Clip -5..5V clamp it, and the two Fold entries fold at 0-10V and at -5V to 5V.
X-port and Y-port — on a mix channel's dot on the field, reading its position CV as 0V..10V or -5V..5V.
Motion-Sequence — on a mix channel's dot on the field, picking its sequence slot, its interpolation and its trigger mode.
